verdict.rationale: Only the data-handling part of the story is documented in plain language: a security FAQ states a default 30-day retention, a per-team Zero Data Retention option, and a response header that confirms ZDR status. Nothing in the pack documents an acceptable-use or prohibited-uses policy, and the published price tables are not commercial terms of use (output ownership, permitted commercial use). missing for 10: documented prohibited-uses/acceptable-use policy, commercial terms of service (output ownership, resale/commercial rights), independent corroboration of policy clarity.

support.subject: As a founder, the usage policy is clear about what I may build — prohibited uses, commercial terms, and data-handling commitments in plain language

citations.quote: ZDR ensures that API request inputs (i.e., your prompt) and outputs ... are never persisted to disk
For teams that require stricter data handling, see [Zero Data Retention (ZDR)](#what-is-zero-data-retention-zdr) below.
